title: Mediterranean Risotto Bowl
description: A keto twist on the classic risotto, served in a bowl with a side of fresh vegetables.
instructions: Heat the Monsoon Olive Oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the Monsoon Garlic and sauté for 1-2 minutes until fragrant.
Add the Fregola and cook for 2-3 minutes until lightly toasted.
Add the Risotto and Mediterranean Sea Salt. Cook for 5-7 minutes until the Risotto is lightly toasted.
Stir in the Fresh Parsley and Fresh Basil.
Serve the Risotto mixture in a bowl and garnish with additional parsley and basil if desired.
Optional: Top with a fried egg or grilled shrimp for added protein.
